How it works

Three steps, and there's a castle in your yard

1

Message us

WhatsApp or call and tell us the date, where the party's at, and roughly how old the kids are.

2

We suggest a setup

Small yard, big crowd, whatever — we'll point you to a castle, slide or trampoline that actually fits.

3

We show up and handle it

We set up, stick around to keep an eye on things, then pack it all up when the fun's done.

Why parents keep booking us

We don't just drop it and go

Someone from our team stays the whole time, watching the equipment and the kids.

It's clean when it lands

We check and wipe down every setup before it leaves us, so it's ready the moment it's up.

Delivery, blowing it up, taking it down again — that's on us. You just host the party.

Questions people ask us

How far in advance should I book?

Honestly, sometimes we can do the same week. But give us 3–5 days if you can, especially for weekends and December — those book out fast.

Is someone on-site to supervise?

Yes, always. Every booking comes with someone watching the equipment and the kids for the whole event — it's not extra.

What space do you need at my venue?

Just send us a rough idea of your compound size on WhatsApp — we'll tell you what fits without cramping the party.

So, when's the party?

Drop us your date on WhatsApp and we'll let you know right away if we're free.
